title: The sudden write is derived; a second laboratory agrees; each type's late-copied excess is a continuum
set_out: Carry IAM's Law forward from the moment of actualization to the horizon ledger, in long form; finish the second laboratory and each cell type's own level (A8) with the full chain; fix the chain's routing of mixed sequencing files; keep the machines working and the records consolidated.
open_at_turnover: The CD4 library of the second laboratory (re-aligning); the binding-at-the-half checks' rerun; what orders A8's continuum (restore crew, solo-WCGW split); which sudden event was the first write; the 3/16 coefficient and eta; the one database's next steps.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Second laboratory, same donor (PHY-084, the referee test)
entries.what: B cells, CD8 and monocytes from GSE173787 at full depth through the one button.
entries.outcome: 3 of 3 inside their atlas bands; a common between-lab offset of -6.1 % (sd 1.7 %); the order test waits for CD4.

entries.title: Each type's late-copied excess (A8), sealed test
entries.what: 13 atlas libraries never used before, read on each type's own family timing.
entries.outcome: Not met, 8 of 13: immune and endothelial 7 of 7 high as predicted, but 5 of 6 others also high.

entries.title: Mixture routing (chain overhaul E2b; COM-IAMA-054)
entries.what: A purity check on 154 sorted libraries set the mixture floor; a mixed file is no longer read as its largest cell.

entries.title: The sudden write (long form link 1)
entries.what: Classical and quantum checks of when a write splits its energy exactly in half.
entries.outcome: Classical 11 of 11 met; quantum 6 of 8 (two numeric bars I set were missed as written).
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): a derivation and its checks

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: What 'sudden' means
entries.what: A write pays the exact half only when it is about as fast as its surface's own light-crossing time; the Standard Model electroweak crossover is far too slow to write.
entries.outcome: The first sudden write is not yet identified.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes and what caught them

entries.title: A watcher cancelled a running alignment
entries.what: A watcher the agent started wrongly cancelled the CD4 library's alignment; two merge-only resends failed.
